verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase is documented as a serverless framework that automatically runs backend code in response to background events (firebase-docs-7, firebase-docs-42). Its functions can respond to Firebase Authentication triggers among other Firebase features (firebase-docs-29), and Identity Platform adds auth blocking functions (firebase-docs-28); a community user confirms running production Functions alongside Firestore (firebase-comm-11). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Firestore/Realtime Database triggers (only implied by 'background events'), independent hands-on corroboration of event-triggered functions specifically.
